name: fishball-connector
//version: The package version is the release's (user decision 2026-11-07: 0.1.0-alpha.0 for both packages). It is independent of the contract version, which lives only in CONNECTOR_CONTRACT (1.1) and is checked when an instance attaches (design §0.2).
description: Fishball's body in DeepSeek Harness: manages your sessions for Fishball (Hand over, message_fishball, permission requests, questions, watches) and connects an external Fishball instance through the documented fishball-connector contract (./contract).
//exports: ./records is the card record's browser module (design §0.2). It is the client bundle's package-local chunk client.records.js, because DSH serves only client.*.js siblings of client.js; importing it outside a DSH page registers nothing.
//peerDependencies: Host packages are resolved from the running DSH installation (verified in spike S8). '*' because engines.dsh is the real compatibility gate.
